basic_details.job_title: DHFWS Purba Medinipur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 67 Pharmacist, Staff Nurse and More Posts
basic_details.department: Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal (under NHM/NUHM)
basic_details.total_vacancies: Medical Officer-AYUSH(MHT) (Male and Female), Pharmacist, Public Health Manager, Block Data Manager, Staff Nurse and other posts
basic_details.short_information: There are 67 contractual vacancies across 10 posts under NHM/NUHM in Purba Medinipur district. The posts are Medical Officer-AYUSH(MHT) (Male and Female), Pharmacist, Public Health Manager, Block Data Manager, Staff Nurse, Community Health Assistant (Urban), Multi Rehabilitation Worker under NPHCE, STLS and STS. Monthly remuneration ranges from Rs.13,000 to Rs.35,000, and the first contract period runs up to 31.03.2027. The District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Purba Medinipur, under the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal, will accept online applications only,

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 26 November 2026 (midnight); registration and fee payment by 25 November 2026

content_sections.heading: About Purba Medinipur NHM
content_sections.text: The District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Purba Medinipur District is a registered samiti (Registration No. S/IL/10904 of 2002-2003). Its office is at Tamluk, Purba Medinipur, PIN - 721636. The Samiti engages contractual staff under NHM/NUHM for the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal. This notice, Recruitment Notice-I, is signed by Dr. Bibhash Roy, CMOH & Secretary of the Samiti.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The 67 vacancies are split across 10 posts as shown below. The figures are copied from the notice. A blank cell means the notice gives no seat in that category for that post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process and Scale of Scoring
content_sections.text: Candidates are ranked by marks under each post's Scale of Scoring. Academic marks are proportionate to the percentage obtained. Some posts also carry a computer test, marks for experience or an interview. Proportionate marking means the percentage obtained in the exam multiplied by the maximum marks for that item, divided by 100. For example, class 10 marks for a Medical Officer are % obtained × 20/100. All marks are calculated excluding marks of Additional Subject. Proportionate marking is considered up to 2 decimal points. Original testimonials are verified. Candidates without the registration form will not be entertained for this verification. Candidates must go through all stages of recruitment. A candidate who skips any stage will be disqualified immediately. The date, time and venue of interview and the short listing of candidates will be published on www.wbhealth.gov.in and www.purbamedinipur.gov.in .

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Purba Medinipur NHM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only online applications will be accepted. Applications are made in the prescribed format on the Department's website. The fee has to be deposited through online mode only and is non-refundable. From 4 November 2026, fill in the online application in the prescribed format on the Department's website. Upload a proper signature and photograph with the application. Complete registration and pay the fee online by 25 November 2026. Complete full submission of the application form by midnight of 26 November 2026. Download the print copy of the online registration form from http://hr.wbhealth.gov.in/Index.aspx using "Application Print". Keep it for document verification. Keep the online registration number for future reference. The employer is not liable to give any information about it later. There is no need to send the hard copy or print copy of the online registration form by post.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Print copy of the online registration form, needed at document verification. Original testimonials, for verification. Experience certificate from the appointing authority with all the details listed above (where experience applies). Caste certificate issued on or before the first date of online application by the competent authorities of West Bengal only (wherever applicable). Registration Certificate of the Respective Council (Medical Officer-AYUSH), West Bengal Pharmacy Council registration (Pharmacist), and WBNC registration (Staff Nurse, CHA (U)). Permanent two wheeler driving license (STLS, STS).

content_sections.text: Forms that are not properly filled in, or are incomplete, are liable to be cancelled. Meeting the essential criteria does not by itself entitle a candidate to selection. A candidate found ineligible at any stage will not be called for the later stages. The competent authorities may cancel the recruitment process at any stage. Their decision on the recruitment is final and binding. Any corrigendum or addendum, and further details of the recruitment process, will be published on www.wbhealth.gov.in and www.purbamedinipur.gov.in .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Purba Medinipur NHM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 67 vacancies across 10 posts. The largest are Pharmacist (17), Community Health Assistant (Urban) (12) and Multi Rehabilitation Worker under NPHCE (12).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of registration and fee payment is 25 November 2026. Full submission of the application form must be done by midnight of 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Medical Officer-AYUSH(MHT)?
faq.answer: A BHMS/BAMS/BUMS degree from an institution recognized by the respective Council is required, along with completed compulsory internship and council registration. Candidates holding an MD in Homeopathy/Ayurvedic/Unani get additional marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years as on 01.01.2026 for all posts. The minimum age is 18 years for Pharmacist and 21 years for Public Health Manager, Block Data Manager, Multi Rehabilitation Worker, STLS and STS. Relaxation is as per Govt. Norms for all posts except STLS and STS.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration ranges from Rs.13,000.00 (CHA (U)) to Rs.35,000.00 (Public Health Manager). Medical Officer-AYUSH(MHT) gets Rs.32,000.00 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.100/- for General categories and Rs.50/- for Reserve categories. It is paid online only and is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online in the prescribed format on the Department's website between 4 November 2026 and midnight of 26 November 2026. Afterwards, download the print copy from http://hr.wbhealth.gov.in/Index.aspx under "Application Print" and keep it for document verification.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by marks under each post's Scale of Scoring, mainly proportionate academic marks. Public Health Manager, Block Data Manager, STLS and STS also have a computer test. Multi Rehabilitation Worker has 5 marks for interview.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely contractual, with an initial period up to 31.03.2027. The contract is likely to be extended on satisfactory performance and approval of Govt.

faq.question: Q10. Can male candidates apply for Community Health Assistant (Urban)?
faq.answer: No. Only female candidates may apply for CHA (U). They must be permanent residents of Purba Medinipur, proficient in Bengali, and hold an ANM or GNM course registered with WBNC.
